# Synthetic PGP ASCII-armored private key block for scanner testing.
# Body is deliberately not a real key. This is the real-world GPG export
# header form (with the " BLOCK" suffix), not the bare "-----BEGIN PGP
# PRIVATE KEY-----" form used elsewhere in this fixture set.
-----BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----

VEhJUyBJUyBOT1QgQSBSRUFMIEtFWSAtIFNZTlRIRVRJQyBGT1IgVEVTVElORw==
-----END PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----
